0022600188.text: The Warriors, who are 4-3 and riding a four-game winning streak, host the 2-4 Heat in their 9th game of the season, with Golden State 2nd in the Pacific and 8th in the West while Miami sits 10th in the East. Golden State is missing Al Horford (rest), Brandon Williams (quadriceps bruise), Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Warriors won the most recent meeting 135-112 in San Francisco on January 19, 2026; they have not yet played each other this season.
